facts.text: Nobu Hotel at Caesars Palace is the world's first Nobu Hotel.
facts.excerpt: The world's first Nobu Hotel

facts.text: Nobu Hotel occupies a separate tower at Caesars Palace, in the center of the Las Vegas Strip.
facts.excerpt: Situated inside a separate tower at Caesars Palace, nestled within the center of strip action and excitement

facts.text: The hotel is furnished with zen plum and gold accent furnishings and artwork.
facts.excerpt: guests will feel miles away from Vegas with the zen plum and gold accent furnishings and clever artwork

facts.text: The decor of the Nobu Deluxe rooms is inspired by kintsugi, the Japanese art of repairing broken pottery with gold epoxy.
facts.excerpt: Décor is inspired from kintsugi, the Japanese art of repairing broken pottery with gold epoxy.

facts.text: Partial Strip View rooms are on the upper floors of Nobu Hotel.
facts.excerpt: Located on the upper floors of Nobu Hotel, experience the sights of Las Vegas with a partial Strip View.

facts.text: The Hakone Suite draws its inspiration from Japan's Fuji-Hakone National Park.
facts.excerpt: Drawing inspiration from Fuki-Hakone National Park, this luxe Las Vegas suite transports the beauty of Japan to the heart of the Strip.

facts.text: The Nobu Villa is a Japanese-inspired rooftop villa with a large patio overlooking the Strip and a secluded Zen garden with an Italian-made whirlpool.
facts.excerpt: The Japanese-inspired rooftop villa has a massive patio overlooking the Strip. It features a barbecue pit, full bar, fire and water fixture, and a secluded Zen garden with an Italian-made whirlpool.

facts.text: The Nobu Penthouse has a curved staircase with a second-story terrace and a stone hearth wall.
facts.excerpt: The Las Vegas suite features a curved staircase with a second-story terrace, a stone hearth wall and sleek Japanese-inspired décor.

facts.text: Nobu Hotel suite guests get complimentary rides within a 10-mile radius in the hotel's Porsche house cars, subject to availability.
facts.excerpt: Guests staying in a Nobu Hotel suite can enjoy complimentary transportation within a 10-mile radius of the resort in one of our exclusive Porsche house cars, subject to availability.

facts.text: Butler service is included in all Penthouse and Villa bookings.
facts.excerpt: Experience seamless luxury with butler service, included in all Penthouse and Villa bookings.

facts.text: Nobu Penthouse and Villa guests receive complimentary airport transfers in a luxury Escalade.
facts.excerpt: Nobu Penthouse and Villa guests receive complimentary airport transfers via luxury Escalade.

facts.text: Guests have the exclusive Nobu Pool plus access to all seven Caesars Palace pools.
facts.excerpt: the exclusive Nobu Pool with access to all seven Caesars Palace pools.

facts.text: The Tanoshi Wellness Hour is a nightly rotation of calming rituals, from sound bowls to tea moments, in the Nobu Hotel Living Room.
facts.excerpt: Experience a nightly rotation of calming rituals offered in the serene Nobu Hotel Living Room—ranging from meditative sound bowls to refined tea moments

facts.text: Qua Spa at Caesars Palace has three Roman baths and a snowing Arctic Ice Room.
facts.excerpt: Three Roman baths use the ancient healing powers of water, while the snowing Arctic Ice Room is the only one of its kind in the world.

facts.text: Qua's spa grounds cover 50,000 square feet and include a Laconium Room and a Crystal Body Art Room.
facts.excerpt: Envelop yourself in Qua’s sprawling, 50,000-square-foot spa grounds that include a Laconium Room and Crystal Body Art Room.

facts.text: Nobu Hotel has its own private fitness area for guests.
facts.excerpt: Exclusive aceess to Nobu's private fitness area

facts.text: Nobu Hotel guests receive dedicated concierge service and priority seating at Nobu Restaurant.
facts.excerpt: Guests of Nobu Hotel receive dedicated Concierge service and enjoy priority seating in Nobu Restaurant.

facts.text: Guests can order Nobu dishes from in-room dining around the clock.
facts.excerpt: guests will be able to order the Nobu dishes they crave around the clock

facts.text: Bowed bamboo columns line the exterior of the Nobu restaurant and lounge, resembling a traditional Japanese ikebana basket.
facts.excerpt: bowed columns of bamboo line the exterior of the restaurant and lounge to resemble the structure of the traditional Japanese ikebana basket used for the art of flower-arranging.

facts.text: Nobu's nature theme is reminiscent of a quiet Japanese garden.
facts.excerpt: Nobu's nature theme is reminiscent of a quiet Japanese garden

facts.text: The Caesars Palace casino is steps away from the Nobu Hotel rooms.
facts.excerpt: Raise the stakes at the sprawling Caesars Palace casino, only steps away from your Nobu hotel room.

facts.text: OMNIA nightclub and several bars and lounges are an elevator ride away from Nobu Hotel.
facts.excerpt: Head to OMNIA and several sophisticated Las Vegas bars and lounges, all just an elevator ride away.

facts.text: The Nobu Villa and Penthouse rooms have custom handcrafted Japanese bedside lanterns.
facts.excerpt: the rooms include luxurious furnishings with custom handcrafted Japanese bedside lanterns

facts.text: Nobu Hotel is pet friendly and welcomes dogs.
facts.excerpt: Bring your dog and stay in one of the best pet-friendly hotels in Las Vegas.

facts.text: Porsche house cars carry up to three guests and cannot take large luggage.
facts.excerpt: Each ride accommodates up to three guests (including passenger seat next to driver). House cars cannot accommodate large luggage.

facts.text: AAA has recognized Nobu Hotel Caesars Palace with the Four Diamond designation.
facts.excerpt: AAA has recognized Nobu Hotel Caesars Palace with the Four Diamond designation

facts.text: Nobu Socials, a complimentary Friday cocktail with the management team on the 72nd floor, is listed as currently unavailable.
facts.excerpt: All Nobu Hotel guests can enjoy a unique, complimentary cocktail along with a Hotel management team meet and greet.

facts.text: The spa is described as world-class.
facts.excerpt: A visit to this world-class spa on the Las Vegas Strip offers luxurious treatments
